difficultyRationale: Requires knowing which monitor is acquired by synchronized instance and static methods.
prompt: Which statements about `synchronized` methods are correct? Select all that apply.
explanation: A synchronized instance method locks the monitor associated with the receiver object. A synchronized static method locks the monitor associated with the Class object representing the declaring class.

options.text: A synchronized instance method locks the receiver object's monitor.
options.explanation: The receiver is the monitor target for an instance synchronized method.

options.text: A synchronized static method locks the Class object for the class.
options.explanation: Static synchronized methods synchronize on the class's Class object.

options.text: Every synchronized method locks the same JVM-wide global monitor.
options.explanation: Synchronization is associated with particular object monitors, not one universal monitor.

options.text: A synchronized static method locks an arbitrary instance of the class.
options.explanation: No instance receiver exists for a static method; the Class object is used.
